# MT Classes Motihari

> MT Classes is a coaching institute in S.K. Nagar, Motihari (East Champaran, Bihar, India) that teaches CBSE Maths and Science to students of Classes 8, 9 and 10. Director: Mohit Thakur. The website has free chapter-wise notes with NCERT answers and CBSE board questions, animated video lessons, free online MCQ tests and online attendance for parents.

- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 70916 09997
- Email: mtclassesmotihari@gmail.com
- Address: S.K. Nagar (Sri Krishna Nagar), Motihari, East Champaran, Bihar 845401 (Google Maps plus code 7MR6JWW8+X74)
- Batches: Class 8 — Maths & Science (Mon – Sat, 5:30 – 6:30 PM); Class 9 — Maths & Science (Mon – Sat, 4:30 – 5:30 PM); Class 10 — Maths & Science (Mon – Sat, 6:30 – 8:00 AM)
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@MTClassesMotihari

## Class 10 notes

- [Maths: Real Numbers](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-maths-real-numbers.html): Class 10 Maths (NCERT) Chapter 1, Real Numbers: colourful CBSE board notes on the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic, prime factorisation with factor trees, HCF and LCM by prime factorisation, HCF × LCM = product, word problems (bells, rooms, tiles, runners), proofs that √2, √3, √5 are irrational, 4 live labs, an activity for every topic, 3 games, CBSE board questions 2023–2026 with step marks, section-wise practice, a quiz and all NCERT answers.
- [Maths: Polynomials](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-maths-polynomials.html): Class 10 Maths (NCERT) Chapter 2, Polynomials: colourful CBSE board notes on degree and types, geometrical meaning of zeroes with 20+ graphs, parabolas, finding zeroes by splitting the middle term, relationship between zeroes and coefficients (α + β = −b/a, αβ = c/a), forming a quadratic from its zeroes, α² + β² and 1/α + 1/β tricks, cubic polynomials, live parabola, build-a-polynomial and cubic labs, 3 games, CBSE board questions 2023–2026 with step marks, section-wise practice, a quiz and all NCERT answers.
- [Maths: Circles](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-maths-circles.html): Class 10 Maths (NCERT) Chapter 10, Circles, for the CBSE board exam: tangents, Theorem 10.1 and 10.2 with proofs and every NCERT figure, a Tangent Explorer with live working, quadrilateral, incircle, angle and parallel-tangent labs, 6 games, CBSE 2023 to 2026 questions with step marks, section-wise CBSE practice, answers to all 17 NCERT exercise questions and a quiz.
- [Maths: Areas Related to Circles](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-maths-areas-related-to-circles.html): Class 10 Maths (NCERT) Chapter 11, Areas Related to Circles, for the CBSE board exam: sector, segment and arc length with every NCERT figure, a Sector and Segment Explorer with live working, clock, grazing, slice and table-cover labs, 5 games, CBSE 2023 to 2026 questions with marking-scheme steps, section-wise CBSE practice, answers to all 14 NCERT exercise questions and a quiz.
- [Maths: Surface Areas and Volumes](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-maths-surface-areas-and-volumes.html): Class 10 Maths (NCERT) Chapter 12, Surface Areas and Volumes: surface area and volume of combinations of cuboid, cube, cylinder, cone, sphere and hemisphere, with every NCERT figure, a 3D Solid Builder with 9 shapes, CBSE exam blueprint, CBSE board questions 2023 to 2026 with step marks, section-wise practice, a lead-shot lab, 4 games, answers to all 17 NCERT exercise questions and a quiz.
- [Maths: Statistics](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-maths-statistics.html): Class 10 Maths (NCERT) Chapter 13, Statistics: mean of grouped data by the direct, assumed mean and step-deviation methods, mode, median, cumulative frequency and 3 Median = Mode + 2 Mean, with every textbook table worked out, diagrams, 6 calculators, 8 games and puzzles, CBSE board questions 2023 to 2026, answers to all 22 NCERT exercise questions and a quiz.
- [Maths: Probability](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-maths-probability.html): Class 10 Maths (NCERT) Chapter 14, Probability: detailed notes on theoretical probability, equally likely outcomes, elementary, complementary, impossible and sure events, playing cards, coins, dice and the 36 outcomes of two dice, with all the textbook figures, 12 interactive tools, CBSE board questions with answers (2023 to 2026), all 25 NCERT Exercise 14.1 answers and a quiz.
- [Science: Metals and Non-metals](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-science-extraction-of-metals-and-corrosion.html): Class 10 Science, Metals and Non-metals: ores and minerals, activity series and extraction, roasting and calcination, thermit reaction, electrolysis, electrolytic refining, corrosion, rusting, alloys, all equations, board questions and a quiz.
- [Science: Carbon and its Compounds](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-science-carbon-and-its-compounds.html): Class 10 Science Chapter 4, Carbon and its Compounds: covalent bonding and electron dot structures, allotropes, catenation and tetravalency, hydrocarbons, isomers, functional groups, homologous series, IUPAC naming, chemical reactions, ethanol, ethanoic acid, soaps and detergents, NCERT solutions and a quiz.
- [Science: Life Processes](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-science-life-processes.html): Class 10 Science (NCERT) Chapter 5, Life Processes: detailed notes with all the textbook diagrams on photosynthesis, stomata, nutrition in Amoeba and humans, digestion, aerobic and anaerobic respiration, the respiratory system, heart and double circulation, blood vessels, lymph, xylem and phloem, transpiration, the nephron, dialysis and excretion in plants; interactive tools, previous year CBSE board questions with answers (2023 to 2026), all NCERT answers and a quiz.
- [Science: Control and Coordination](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-science-control-and-coordination.html): Class 10 Science (NCERT) Chapter 6, Control and Coordination: detailed notes with all the textbook diagrams on the neuron, synapse, neuromuscular junction, reflex arc, human brain, the sensitive plant, tendrils, phototropism, geotropism, plant hormones (auxin, gibberellins, cytokinins, abscisic acid), adrenaline, endocrine glands, thyroxin, growth hormone, insulin and feedback; interactive tools, previous year CBSE board questions with answers (2023 to 2026), all NCERT answers and a quiz.
- [Science: How do Organisms Reproduce?](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-science-how-do-organisms-reproduce-ncert.html): Class 10 Science (NCERT) Chapter 7, How do Organisms Reproduce?: detailed notes with the textbook diagrams on DNA copying, variation, fission, budding, regeneration, vegetative propagation, spores, flowers, pollination, fertilisation, human reproductive systems and reproductive health, interactive tools, previous year CBSE board questions with answers (2023 to 2026), all NCERT answers and a quiz.
- [Science: Heredity](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-science-heredity.html): Class 10 Science (NCERT) Chapter 8, Heredity: detailed notes with the textbook diagrams on variation, Mendel's experiments, dominant and recessive traits, monohybrid and dihybrid crosses (3:1 and 9:3:3:1), genes, chromosomes and sex determination, a Punnett square builder and other interactive tools, previous year CBSE board questions with answers (2023 to 2026), all NCERT answers and a quiz.
- [Science: Light – Reflection and Refraction](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-science-light-reflection-refraction.html): Class 10 Science (NCERT) Chapter 9, Light – Reflection and Refraction: colourful CBSE board notes with 40+ ray diagrams for concave and convex mirrors and lenses, laws of reflection and refraction, sign convention, mirror and lens formula, magnification, refractive index, power of a lens, live mirror, lens and Snell's law labs, an activity for every topic, 3 games, CBSE board questions 2024–2026 with step marks, section-wise practice, a quiz and all NCERT answers.
- [Science: The Human Eye and the Colourful World](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-science-human-eye-colourful-world.html): Class 10 Science (NCERT) Chapter 10, The Human Eye and the Colourful World: colourful CBSE board notes with realistic eye diagrams, power of accommodation, myopia, hypermetropia and presbyopia with ray diagrams and lens power, refraction through a prism, dispersion, rainbow, atmospheric refraction, twinkling of stars, scattering, Tyndall effect, blue sky and red sunset, 6 live labs, an activity for every topic, 3 games, CBSE board questions 2024–2026 with step marks, section-wise practice, a quiz and all NCERT answers.
- [Science: Magnetic Effects of Electric Current](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class10-science-ac-dc-household-circuits.html): Class 10 Science, Magnetic Effects of Electric Current: AC and DC, domestic electric circuits, earthing, short circuit, overloading, fuse and MCB, solved numericals, board questions and a quiz.

## Class 9 notes

- [Maths: Circles](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class9-maths-circles.html): Class 9 Maths (NCERT Ganita Manjari) Chapter 5, Circles: chords, symmetry, circumcircle, all 12 theorems proved step by step, angle in a semicircle, cyclic quadrilaterals, solutions to every Think and Reflect, Exercise Sets 5.1 to 5.6 and all 26 end-of-chapter exercises.
- [Maths: Measuring Space: Perimeter and Area](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class9-maths-perimeter-and-area.html): Class 9 Maths (NCERT Ganita Manjari) Chapter 6, Measuring Space: Perimeter and Area. Easy notes with textbook diagrams on pi, arc length, area of triangles, Heron's and Brahmagupta's formulas, area of a circle and sectors, solutions to every exercise and a quiz.
- [Maths: The Mathematics of Maybe: Probability](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class9-maths-probability.html): Class 9 Maths (NCERT Ganita Manjari) Chapter 7, The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability. Easy notes with textbook diagrams, a coin and dice lab, two-dice explorer, tree diagram builder, spinner and dye-drop simulators, solutions to every exercise, a formula sheet and a quiz.
- [Maths: Predicting What Comes Next: Sequences and Progressions](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class9-maths-sequences-and-progressions.html): Class 9 Maths (NCERT Ganita Manjari) Chapter 8, Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions. Easy notes with textbook diagrams, a number machine, recursive rule stepper, AP and GP explorer, staircase sum builder, fractal zoomer, bouncing ball lab, solutions to every exercise, a formula sheet and a quiz.
- [Science: Tissues in Action](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class9-science-tissues-in-action.html): Class 9 Science (NCERT Exploration) Chapter 3, Tissues in Action: detailed notes with textbook diagrams on meristems, permanent tissues, xylem and phloem, epithelial, connective, muscular and nervous tissue, joints and the skeleton, interactive tools, all NCERT answers and a quiz.
- [Science: Simple Machines](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class9-science-simple-machines.html): Class 9 Science (NCERT Exploration) Chapter 7, Section 7.6 Simple Machines: mechanical advantage, fixed and movable pulleys, inclined plane MA = L/h, principle of the lever, classes of levers, solved examples, textbook answers, practice questions and a quiz.
- [Science: Journey Inside the Atom](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class9-science-journey-inside-the-atom.html): Class 9 Science (NCERT Exploration) Chapter 8, Journey Inside the Atom: easy notes with diagrams, atomic models, electronic configuration, valency, isotopes, isobars, NCERT answers and a quiz.
- [Science: Atomic Foundations of Matter](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class9-science-atomic-foundations-of-matter.html): Class 9 Science (NCERT Exploration) Chapter 9, Atomic Foundations of Matter: easy notes with textbook diagrams on laws of chemical combination, Dalton's theory, covalent and ionic bonds, chemical formulae, molecular mass, all NCERT answers and a quiz.
- [Science: Reproduction: How Life Continues](https://www.mtclassesmotihari.com/notes/class9-science-reproduction-how-life-continues.html): Class 9 Science (NCERT Exploration) Chapter 11, Reproduction: How Life Continues: detailed notes with textbook diagrams on budding, spores, cutting, grafting, layering, tissue culture, meiosis, flower parts, pollination, fertilisation, animal and human reproduction, the menstrual cycle, interactive tools, all NCERT answers and a quiz.

## FAQ

- **Which classes and subjects are taught?** Maths and Science for Classes 8, 9 and 10 (CBSE).
- **How do I take an online test?** Open the Online Test page, choose your class and chapter, enter your name and start. You get your score and solutions immediately.
- **How can parents check attendance?** Open the Attendance page, choose 'Student / Parent' and enter the roll number and code given by the institute.
- **Where do I get notes?** The Notes page has chapter-wise notes for each class. Quick-revision notes can be read online and printed.
- **How do I join?** Fill the enquiry form on the Contact page or message us on WhatsApp to book a free demo class.
